title: 554MW of battery storage enters AEMO’s Market Management System in Australia

title: U.S. solar module production reaches historic 100 GW landmark
content:
The United States crossed 100 GW of cumulative solar PV module production during Q2 2026, according to a new bottom-up factory-level analysis by Terawatt PV Research going back to the early 1970’s. Almost two-fifths of all module production can be attributed to First Solar - a reflection of the company's unique role in U.S. manufacturing dating back more than 20 years.

The company says its refurbished systems can cost around 30% less than new batteries while extending battery service life by several decades.

title: Predictive control cuts costs in buildings combining PV, heat pumps, EVs, thermal storage
content:
Researchers have developed a predictive rule-based control strategy for building energy systems integrating PV, heat pumps, thermal storage, and electric vehicles. Simulations show it can approach model predictive control performance while substantially reducing computational requirements and operating costs compared with conventional rule-based control.

title: Study finds potential for 150 GW of additional PV at substations in Germany
content:
A Fraunhofer IEE study estimates that battery storage could enable around 150 GW of additional PV capacity to connect at 1,313 rural substations in Germany. By absorbing generation peaks, storage could improve utilization of existing transformers while limiting average PV curtailment to around 1%.
